title: af/doctor@1
description: `af doctor --json` (ADR-0201): one token-free health check of this machine and, when it runs in a git repository, that repository. Each check is `ok`, `warn` or `fail`, with a one-line `fix` whenever it is not `ok`. Checks appear in this order, `project` only inside a repository: `binary` (the running af, its install receipt and how it was verified, the default link), `path` (the default link's directory on PATH, and whether `af` on PATH is that link), `shell` (completions and man pages for $SHELL), `update` (the cached release check, a newer release, the policy, the release source's anonymous reachability), `tools` (git >= 2.30, curl, minisign, gh when curl is missing, and what the repository's Gate runs), `providers` (the registry, each registered Provider's login from the token-free status probe, logins found but not registered), `storage` (what af keeps against `[storage] max_bytes`, free disk against `min_free_bytes`, abandoned install stagings), `project` (`.af/` validating, the lock's af pin, each Gate command, a Provider for every model Worker kind). `exit_code` is 1 when any check failed and 0 otherwise, the command's own exit code. The command never calls a model, logs in, installs or writes a file.

fix.description: The one command or action that fixes what the check found; null exactly when the check is `ok`.
